- 不得虚构授权、能力、证据、产品支持，或为未维护场景推导可执行路线。
- Core 规则不依赖具体产品；受支持的运行环境分支和模型绑定见运行环境与模型厂商支持 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"delegation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.081374cfbaa37b57"],"max_chars":12188})`)。
- 按需读取 reference。不要仅因为可能以后有用，就预加载整个 Skill、`references/` 或原始项目状态。

# 工作定义模块


本 Layer-04 模块用当前事实建立任务上下文，并产出符合 Contract 的决策及默认共享任务计划。它不选择执行者、不评估输出路由、不预留角色、不释放 Slice，也不执行 Bootstrap。

## 入口声明

| 字段 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 必需输入 | 当前已授权 Contract 和任务范围、已释放路线/模式证据、当前规范 Session state 和已完成的审计读回、已知任务事实/来源指针、取得所需 Context 的已授权可用方式，以及调用方 continuation/效果状态。WD01 建立当前 Context；它不是入口前置条件。 |
| 允许效果 | 有界且已授权的只读 Context 检索；仅在已有授权的当前 Root Session 下请求符合条件的语义建议；在既有授权内默认持久化任务计划，并遵守明确持久化限制。不得执行 executor/output 路由、角色预留、Slice 释放、Bootstrap、实施或子代理派发。 |
| 结果 | 本模块以当前有来源的 Context、符合 Contract 的 Decision/未释放边界，以及计划证据或有依据的子步骤 `not_applicable` 返回 `complete`；否则返回带暂停位置的 `needs_prerequisite` 或 `blocked`。Context/建议/计划子步骤可根据触发证据标为 `not_applicable`，但不得整体跳过必需的工作定义模块。建议是待审证据，不是授权。 |
| 新鲜度 | 保留来源/出处/新鲜度及相关 input/policy hash 和 epoch。建议或依赖决策前重新确认；实质变化会使受影响证据失效，并要求调用方从受影响子步骤重新进入。 |

## 工作流路线图


## 有序模块清单

1. **WD00 — 解析入口。** 提供本声明、当前已授权 Contract 和任务范围、已释放路线/模式证据、当前规范 Session state 和已完成的审计读回、已知任务事实/来源指针、取得所需 Context 的已授权可用方式，以及 continuation/效果状态，调用模块入口解析 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.f56021d97f9b69f7"],"max_chars":5406})`)。规范 state 和已完成审计读回是必需输入；当前任务 Context 在 WD01 建立。从记录的子步骤恢复。缺少前置条件时，连同语义 owner 一起返回；冲突或无法恢复的状态则阻塞。没有已授权的当前 Session 时，不请求建议。
2. **WD01 — 建立有界当前 Context。** 应用Context (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.d2e88709b902fca6"],"max_chars":5458})`)、上下文来源选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.84732faf33a5ac47"],"max_chars":6330})`)和Session Context Firewall (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.95aba471482062c9"],"max_chars":5627})`)。定义下一项任务所需的最小问题，只检查必需来源。计划内容在当前上下文中有效时直接复用；否则按需获取匹配的 active plan Memory。当前指令优先，plan 不授予授权。仅在所需内容缺失或过期时读取相关可复用 Memory，并核验来源指针/新鲜度；如果没有或不可用，返回经批准的权威项目来源，只有必需事实仍无法核实时才阻塞。仅在触发有界规则查询时使用Workflow Rule Context (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.b2c56bb76a6f6521"],"max_chars":3635})`)，确认 owner/语言/来源/hash，并读取被摘录省略的直接 owner。仅在需要项目/代码结构证据时应用LSP MCP Tools (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.eb35e270023c9aac"],"max_chars":10358})`)；否则记录 `not_applicable` 及原因。返回有来源的当前事实、来源链、新鲜度/epoch 和限制；过期、冲突或缺失的关键事实会阻塞依赖决策。
   - 若下游 Decision 建议需要审阅背景，应用决策上下文选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.caa7baa69e1cbe03"],"max_chars":4404})`)和Decision Context Generation (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.4d8491f91935afe9"],"max_chars":5163})`)：只提供有界事实和具体目标，审查忠实度/相关性/来源，并核验准确的输入/政策绑定。拒绝过期或不匹配背景；若建议不需要生成背景，记录 `not_applicable` 及原因。
   - 仅在 Multi-Agent 模式下，若上下文来源选择 owner 确认触发了持久化交换或 memo 前置条件，则只按该触发检查相应的Context Exchange (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.439bedbb36334cd3"],"max_chars":4842})`)、工作区边界 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.0a54c601ab09a7e6"],"max_chars":5042})`)、交接 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.2d0f4872b823ef44"],"max_chars":4744})`)或Content Memo Dispatch (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.90ad9fe16c44d13f"],"max_chars":4476})`) owner。确认必需的当前记录和 Memory 证据；不得仅为收集 Context 创建交换记录，也不得在此派发 memo。未触发时记录 `not_applicable` 及原因。Single-Agent 模式下，这些子代理专属交换和 memo owners 均为 `not_applicable`；不得加载这些 owner。
3. **WD02 — 在 Contract 范围内决策。** 应用Decision (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.41b987be9e704d9b"],"max_chars":3682})`)、执行决策门禁 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.de2827a57b366838"],"max_chars":4138})`)和执行规划 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.bfe4630ffe78e154"],"max_chars":4261})`)。说明实质问题、已核实事实、未知项、选项、所选方向、拒绝的替代方案、授权范围/效果、返回条件和未释放边界。对于仍开放的实质选择，准备必需的 Decision Brief，且只释放侦察；确认 Contract 允许所选方向后再进入后续释放。Session 实质恢复后，仅在调用方要求时于此重评当前 Decision/Contract 证据；不得重开 Mode 或重复已完成的审计提问。
   - 建议是可选的。仅当已有授权的当前 Root Session 存在，且 Decision 阶段符合资格、已启用并且相关时，应用建议选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.a60497211dd34eb4"],"max_chars":4058})`)和Decisions Advisory (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.4d827a8a683055da"],"max_chars":4800})`)。否则依赖直接 owner 并将建议记录为带原因的 `not_applicable`。根据当前直接 owner 证据和 hash 审查任何建议；建议不会选择或授权工作。
   - 任务阶段建议是独立的可选输入。仅当 WD01 事实当前有效、锁定的 mode/count 与所选路线已直接确认，且建议路径符合条件、已启用并获授权时，才应用工作流路由建议 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.c8db0a91e134c7a6"],"max_chars":4652})`)。它可以建议恢复时的当前阶段/模块；任何可用建议都须根据当前所选路线及来源/政策哈希审阅。它不会改变路线或 mode/count、通过门禁、选择执行者/输出或释放工作。未选择或不符合条件时，记录有原因的 `not_applicable` 并按当前路线继续。如果所选路径必需能力不可用或证据过期/不足，返回以取得当前证据或阻塞该依赖路径；不得静默回退。此项与上方现有 Decision 建议保持分离。
   - 执行者选择和输出路由不属于本模块范围，仍由之后另行授权的执行路径处理。
4. **WD03 — 解决默认共享任务计划。** 调用规划输出选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.4212a614b3f2a7f0"],"max_chars":4238})`)，应用任务计划 Memory 生命周期 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.c3c732f022fc8a5e"],"max_chars":10361})`)。无论有无 Issue 或明确规划请求，均综合当前事实与拟议方案，持久化具体计划，并在实施或依赖派发前确认操作成功；owner 要求时才核验内容。确认所选存储范围、仓库身份和对应活动/归档命名空间；共享存储中，同仓库各工作区复用规划，其他仓库保持隔离。按生命周期 owner 解析映射；映射未知或冲突时阻塞，不静默回退。返回准确项目/计划身份、存储映射、允许贡献、持久化确认及 owner 要求的核验证据。仅已记录的明确持久化限制允许使用 owner 的例外；与明确持久化要求冲突、必需访问缺失、写入失败或必需核验失败时阻塞。需求变化先记录，再分析并持久化修订提议，然后才处理受影响工作。只有当前事实、符合 Contract 的 Decision/未释放边界，以及当前计划证据或有依据的限制例外齐备时，才返回 `complete`。这不释放 Slice、不选择执行者，也不授权实施；必需模块不能整体跳过为 `not_applicable`。

en.text:
Apply the current instruction and its included policy sections below. The current actions, guards, evidence and failure boundary are given directly. Before applying a named independent policy, obtain its exact instruction continuation; reuse any already held unit from this build and retain the affected action's return position. Do not retrieve author files or infer omitted policy. Check current facts and authorization before effects; an instruction is not a pass.

## Hard constraints

- Record hard user, runtime environment, repository, permission, safety, and Session constraints before acting.
- A task-level prohibition, such as “do not create subagents” or “do not use a browser,” remains active for the whole task.
- Computer Use is categorically forbidden: never control a computer, browser, or desktop app through its graphical interface — no screenshots to locate controls, mouse or keyboard simulation, clicking, accessibility APIs, window automation, remote-desktop control, or GUI scripting — and do not route such interaction through an API, CLI, MCP server, helper, or another Agent. Treat this as a blacklist rather than a list of allowed channels: every other tool, command, or capability actually exposed to and authorized for the current Session remains permitted. If a required step needs a forbidden operation, stop and report the blocker instead of attempting, delegating, or skipping it.
- Before route selection or any delegation/Session-topology work, the Mode checkpoint must compose and validate the delegation references; those references own conversation-level mode selection with a default Multi-Agent route and one-child budget, child counts, conditional creation, allocation, reuse, replacement, exceptions, and limits at their respective atomic boundaries. A reserved budget never initializes or authorizes a child by itself.
- Never invent authorization, capability, evidence, product support, or an executable route for an unmaintained scenario.
- Keep Core rules independent of product details; read Runtime and Model Provider Support (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"delegation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.081374cfbaa37b57"],"max_chars":24011})`) for supported runtime branches and model bindings.
- Read references on demand. Do not preload the entire Skill, `references/`, or raw project state merely because it may become useful.

# Single-Agent Execution Module


This Layer-04 module composes executor/output disposition, a current controlled Slice, local implementation, stage feedback, and Control for an authorized Single-Agent task. It returns implementation state and provisional evidence to its caller; final verification belongs to the later verification/repair workflow.

## Entry declaration

| Field | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Required inputs | Current authorized task and Contract, released Single-Agent mode, complete current Session/audit, sourced Context and Decision, continuation/effect state, and any recovery floor and current Control evidence. |
| Permitted effects | Resolve executor/output, release and implement an authorized local Slice, contribute authorized plan updates at owner-defined boundaries, provide stage feedback, and resolve Control. No child creation/dispatch, role reservation, scope expansion, or final verification. |
| Results | Return `complete` only with current implementation state, fingerprint, provisional checks, and Control disposition, and no pending recovery/next Slice; otherwise `needs_prerequisite` with continuation or `blocked`. Conditional substeps may be `not_applicable` with reason. |
| Freshness | Bind evidence to current Contract, task/Slice fingerprint, canonical state revision, Control rule, and relevant epochs. Material changes invalidate affected evidence and require re-entry at the specified checkpoint. |

## Workflow map


## Ordered module checklist

1. **SE00 — Resolve entry.** Call Module Entry Resolution (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.f56021d97f9b69f7"],"max_chars":11498})`) with this declaration, current authorization and route/mode evidence, complete Session/audit and Context/Decision evidence, prior effects, recovery state, and continuation. `ready` allows only module checks. Missing evidence returns `needs_prerequisite` with owner and position; conflict, unsafe state, or unrecoverable prior effects return `blocked`.
2. **SE01 — Resolve executor and output independently.** Apply Task Assignment (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.fc70c3abeacbbc75"],"max_chars":17166})`) and Executor Selection (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.7cfce54c55038201"],"max_chars":11534})`), then Output Token Routing (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.6f6bd3f06d2490f7"],"max_chars":12392})`) and Output Route Selection (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.ded605c482a9b142"],"max_chars":10140})`). Under released Single-Agent mode, an explicit `sub_agent` result conflicts with locked Mode and is `blocked`. A direct Root output result of `yes` is a hold at the locked topology boundary; report that boundary and block release without implying that Mode can be changed in this Session. Unknown required executor/output evidence returns `needs_prerequisite`. Continue only when Root execution is current and output has been dispositioned.
3. **SE02 — Apply the current Control gate and release the Slice.** Apply Execution Control (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.b0e2251c1172aa52"],"max_chars":11723})`), Execution Planning (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.bfe4630ffe78e154"],"max_chars":9139})`), and the Delegation State Record (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"delegation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.04519b62e6c4f711"],"max_chars":19848})`). A material change invalidates dependent earlier Control evidence; return to SE05 and re-evaluate from current facts before release/resume. `Stop` blocks. Release only a bounded Slice supported by current Context and Decision, with objective, authorized scope/mutations, return conditions, and unreleased boundary. Update and read back the parent-controlled record under its owner. Apply Task Plan Memory Lifecycle (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.c3c732f022fc8a5e"],"max_chars":27855})`) before release; confirm current plan evidence and persistence, any owner-required verification, or the documented restriction exception; failure blocks dependent release.
4. **SE03 — Implement and return provisional checks.** Apply Implementation (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.4c229b0e79465743"],"max_chars":10588})`). Inspect only needed sources and make the smallest authorized change. When the current executor, output class, capability, separately authorized grant, pinned root, exact paths, and baseline satisfy Output Materialization (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.f6dfdbe9ab2522eb"],"max_chars":11082})`), follow that owner to prepare and inspect a bounded candidate while retaining its manifest identity/hash. Before applying it, follow Candidate Compliance Preflight (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.fe5e2c4674619c83"],"max_chars":9694})`) for a fresh whole-batch preflight against the same pinned root and policy, then recheck current authority, artifact integrity, and baseline and apply that exact candidate. Review receipts and actual current files; preparation, preflight, and receipts are not final Verification. If the optional path is not selected, record `not_applicable` with why and continue only under an independently authorized direct path. A selected required capability/guard/preflight that is missing, failed, unknown, omitted, stale, or uncertain returns `needs_prerequisite` or `blocked` before dependent action; do not silently fall back. Resolve partial, conflict, or uncertain application from actual current state before continuing; never replay over changed content. Use LSP MCP Tools (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.eb35e270023c9aac"],"max_chars":20803})`) only when code-structure evidence is needed and the capability is available. If required LSP semantics are unavailable, state the limitation and use targeted text search and small path-bounded reads; do not call those findings LSP evidence. Record `not_applicable` only when code-structure evidence is not needed. Block if a required relationship remains unknown. Run focused provisional checks, then return changed paths, effects, current fingerprint, check output, receipts/current-state evidence when applicable, and unresolved issues. This is not final verification.
5. **SE04 — Provide stage feedback.** Apply Execution Stage Feedback (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.1199cd05bec7fedb"],"max_chars":11559})`) when its trigger applies, returning a bounded Progress Signal at the material stage boundary. If no trigger applies, record `not_applicable` with observed reason. Both paths continue to SE05; this step never skips Control.
6. **SE05 — Resolve current Control.** Apply Control (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.1be2b692e264c336"],"max_chars":10615})`), Execution Control (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.b0e2251c1172aa52"],"max_chars":11723})`), Advisory Selection (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.a60497211dd34eb4"],"max_chars":8845})`), and Decisions Advisory (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.4d827a8a683055da"],"max_chars":11582})`). Consume current Progress Signal evidence for status, findings, changed scope, verification, issues, needs, and the current unreleased boundary. Use only a current trusted advisory result when eligible, enabled, and authorized; otherwise record advice `not_applicable` with reason and decide from direct current evidence. Preserve the current continuation for each outcome:
   - Missing/stale post-floor `Continue` enters or resumes the same Control check. A fresh recovery `Continue` returns to SE02 for the next/recovered Slice.
   - `Evidence-on-Demand` pauses release and returns `needs_prerequisite`; retain the same Control continuation and return here after evidence arrives.
   - `Amend` returns `needs_prerequisite`; update the Contract and Decision under their owners, and update Context when needed. Then resume this same Control check and obtain a new explicit `Continue` before returning to SE02; the earlier outcome does not release work.
   - `Stop` returns `blocked`.
   - A normal `Continue` with a next Slice returns `needs_prerequisite` for current Context/Decision resolution for that next Slice. Confirm that this `Continue` still covers the new bounded Slice and that the state/epochs remain current. If scope, Contract, authorization, unreleased boundary, or a relevant epoch change invalidates it, resume this Control checkpoint and obtain a new explicit `Continue`; otherwise recheck only changed executor/output evidence at SE01 and continue to SE02 without replaying completed effects. With no next Slice and no pending recovery result, continue to SE06 only when current post-implementation evidence confirms the task is complete.
7. **SE06 — Return implementation state.** Return current evidence that the task's implementation is complete, paths/effects, current fingerprint, provisional check evidence, current Control result and continuation status, plus limitations. Do not claim final verification or final Acceptance; those remain with the later verification/repair and caller workflow.

下列直接给出当前动作、守卫、证据和失败边界。应用独立政策前，先按明确的指令继续入口取得对应单元；同一构建中已持有的单元直接复用，并保留受影响动作的准确恢复位置。不读取作者文件或推测缺失政策。执行副作用前核实当前事实与授权；指令内容可用不表示检查通过。

## 硬约束

- 采取行动前记录用户、运行环境、仓库、权限、安全和 Session 硬约束。
- “不要创建子代理”“不要使用浏览器”等任务级禁止条件在整个任务中持续有效。
- 绝对禁止 Computer Use：不得通过图形界面控制计算机、浏览器或桌面应用——包括以操纵控件为目的的截图、鼠标／键盘模拟、点击、辅助功能 API、窗口自动化、远程桌面控制或 GUI 脚本——也不得把此类交互包装为 API、CLI、MCP Server、辅助程序或其他 Agent 调用来绕过。本节是黑名单而非允许渠道清单：当前 Session 实际暴露且已获授权的其他工具、命令或能力仍然允许。若必需步骤需要借助被禁止的操作，应停止并报告阻塞，而不是尝试、委派或跳过。
- 路线选择或任何委派/Session 拓扑工作前，模式检查点必须组合并验证委派 references；这些 references 在各自的原子边界内规定会话级模式选择及默认多代理路线和单个子代理预算、子代理数量、条件创建、分配、复用、替换、例外和限制。预留预算本身不会初始化或授权创建子代理。
- 不得虚构授权、能力、证据、产品支持，或为未维护场景推导可执行路线。
- Core 规则不依赖具体产品；受支持的运行环境分支和模型绑定见运行环境与模型厂商支持 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"delegation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.081374cfbaa37b57"],"max_chars":12188})`)。
- 按需读取 reference。不要仅因为可能以后有用，就预加载整个 Skill、`references/` 或原始项目状态。

# Single-Agent 执行模块


本 Layer-04 模块组合已授权 Single-Agent 任务的执行者/输出处置、当前受控 Slice、本地实施、阶段反馈和 Control。它向调用方返回实施状态与初步证据；最终验证属于后续验证/修复工作流。

## 入口声明

| 字段 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 必需输入 | 当前已授权任务和 Contract、已释放的 Single-Agent 模式、完整且当前的 Session/审计、有来源的 Context 和 Decision、continuation/效果状态，以及任何恢复底线和当前 Control 证据。 |
| 允许效果 | 解析执行者/输出、释放和实施已授权 Slice、在 owner 规定边界提交获准的计划更新、提供阶段反馈及解决 Control。不得创建/派发子代理、预留角色、扩大范围或进行最终验证。 |
| 结果 | 仅在返回当前实施状态、指纹、初步检查和 Control 处置且无待处理恢复/下一 Slice 时返回 `complete`；否则以 continuation 返回 `needs_prerequisite` 或 `blocked`。条件子步骤可带原因标为 `not_applicable`。 |
| 新鲜度 | 将证据绑定到当前 Contract、任务/Slice 指纹、规范 state revision、Control 规则及相关 epoch。实质变化会使受影响证据失效，并要求从指定检查点重新进入。 |

## 工作流路线图


## 有序模块清单

1. **SE00 — 解析入口。** 提供本声明、当前授权与路线/模式证据、完整 Session/审计和 Context/Decision 证据、先前效果、恢复状态及 continuation，调用模块入口解析 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.f56021d97f9b69f7"],"max_chars":5406})`)。`ready` 只允许模块核验。证据缺失时连同 owner 和位置返回 `needs_prerequisite`；冲突、状态不安全或先前效果无法恢复时返回 `blocked`。
2. **SE01 — 分别解析执行者和输出。** 应用任务分配 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.fc70c3abeacbbc75"],"max_chars":7799})`)和执行者选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.7cfce54c55038201"],"max_chars":5155})`)，再应用输出 Token 路由 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.6f6bd3f06d2490f7"],"max_chars":5294})`)及输出路由选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.ded605c482a9b142"],"max_chars":4628})`)。在已释放 Single-Agent 模式下，明确的 `sub_agent` 结果与锁定 Mode 冲突，返回 `blocked`。Root 直接输出为 `yes` 时，报告锁定的拓扑边界并阻塞 Slice 释放；不得暗示本 Session 可以更改 Mode。必需的执行者/输出证据未知时返回 `needs_prerequisite`。仅当 Root 执行已确认且输出已处置时继续。
3. **SE02 — 应用当前 Control 门禁并释放 Slice。** 应用执行控制 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.b0e2251c1172aa52"],"max_chars":5754})`)、执行规划 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.bfe4630ffe78e154"],"max_chars":4261})`)和委派状态记录 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"delegation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.04519b62e6c4f711"],"max_chars":10907})`)。实质变化会使依赖它的早先 Control 证据失效；释放/恢复前返回 SE05，依据当前事实重新评估。`Stop` 会阻塞。仅释放由当前 Context 和 Decision 支持的有界 Slice，并说明目标、授权范围/修改、返回条件及未释放边界。按 owner 更新并回读父级控制记录。释放前应用任务计划 Memory 生命周期 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.c3c732f022fc8a5e"],"max_chars":10361})`)，确认当前计划证据与持久化、owner 要求的核验或有记录的限制例外；失败时阻塞依赖释放。
4. **SE03 — 实施并返回初步检查。** 应用实施 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.4c229b0e79465743"],"max_chars":4946})`)。仅检查必要来源并作最小授权改动。只有当前执行者、输出 class、capability、单独授权、固定 root、准确路径和 baseline 都符合输出物料化 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.f6dfdbe9ab2522eb"],"max_chars":4802})`)时，才应用该 owner。准备并检查有界候选，保留其 manifest 身份/hash。应用前，按候选合规预检 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.fe5e2c4674619c83"],"max_chars":4101})`)在同一固定 root 和政策下进行新鲜 whole-batch 预检；然后重新核验授权、artifact 完整性和 baseline，再应用准确候选。审阅收据和实际当前文件；准备、预检和收据不是最终 Verification。未选择可选路径时，记录有原因的 `not_applicable`，且仅在独立授权的直接路径下继续。已选路径缺少必需能力/守卫/预检，或返回失败、未知、遗漏、过期、不确定时，在依赖操作前返回 `needs_prerequisite` 或 `blocked`；不得静默回退。部分、冲突或不确定的应用须先根据实际当前状态解决；不得覆盖已改变内容进行重放。仅在需要代码结构证据且能力可用时才使用LSP MCP Tools (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"context","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.eb35e270023c9aac"],"max_chars":10358})`)。所需 LSP 语义不可用时，说明限制并回退到定向文本搜索和路径范围较小的读取；不得将这些发现称为 LSP 证据。只有不需要代码结构证据时才能记录 `not_applicable`。必需关系仍未知时阻塞。运行聚焦的初步检查，返回变更路径、效果、当前指纹、检查输出、适用时的收据/当前状态证据和未解决问题。这不是最终验证。
5. **SE04 — 提供阶段反馈。** 触发时应用执行阶段反馈 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.1199cd05bec7fedb"],"max_chars":5499})`)，在实质阶段边界返回有界 Progress Signal。无触发条件时，记录带观察原因的 `not_applicable`。两条路径都进入 SE05；不得跳过 Control。
6. **SE05 — 解决当前 Control。** 应用Control (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.1be2b692e264c336"],"max_chars":4939})`)、执行控制 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.b0e2251c1172aa52"],"max_chars":5754})`)、建议选择 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.a60497211dd34eb4"],"max_chars":4058})`)及Decisions Advisory (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.4d827a8a683055da"],"max_chars":4800})`)。消费当前 Progress Signal 的 status、findings、change scope、verification、issue、need 和当前未释放边界证据。仅在建议当前可信、符合条件、已启用且已授权时消费；否则记录带原因的建议 `not_applicable`，并根据当前直接证据决策。为各结果保留当前 continuation：
   - post-floor `Continue` 缺失/过期时，进入或恢复同一 Control 检查。新的 recovery `Continue` 返回 SE02 处理下一/恢复 Slice。
   - `Evidence-on-Demand` 暂停释放并返回 `needs_prerequisite`；保留同一 Control continuation，证据到达后回到此处。
   - `Amend` 返回 `needs_prerequisite`；按 owners 更新 Contract 和 Decision，并在需要时更新 Context。随后恢复同一 Control 检查，并取得新的明确 `Continue` 后才返回 SE02；先前结果不释放工作。
   - `Stop` 返回 `blocked`。
   - 普通 `Continue` 后若有下一 Slice，则返回 `needs_prerequisite`，先为该 Slice 解析当前 Context/Decision，并核验此 `Continue` 仍覆盖新的有界 Slice 且状态/epoch 当前。若范围、Contract、授权、未释放边界或相关 epoch 使其失效，则恢复此 Control 检查并取得新的明确 `Continue`；否则仅在 SE01 重核已变化的执行者/输出证据，然后进入 SE02，不重放已完成效果。若没有下一 Slice 且没有待处理恢复结果，只有当前 post-implementation 证据确认任务已完成后才进入 SE06。
7. **SE06 — 返回实施状态。** 返回证据证明当前任务实施已完成、路径/效果、当前指纹、初步检查证据、当前 Control 结果及 continuation 状态，以及限制。不得声称最终验证或最终 Acceptance；这由后续验证/修复及调用方工作流负责。

If a required step needs a forbidden operation, stop and report the blocker instead of attempting, delegating, or skipping it.
- Before route selection or any delegation/Session-topology work, the Mode checkpoint must compose and validate the delegation references; those references own conversation-level mode selection with a default Multi-Agent route and one-child budget, child counts, conditional creation, allocation, reuse, replacement, exceptions, and limits at their respective atomic boundaries. # Coding Delegation Mode Confirmation

## General rules

### Session mode selection

On the first Coding directive in a host-identified Session lifetime, the root parent must:

1. Honor an explicit valid mode/count choice in the directive without asking again.
2. If no valid choice is present, present this numbered menu. Only when the Mode gate must be released and there is still no valid user choice, use the stated default; an unanswered prompt by itself does not require releasing the gate. Explicit no-preference also selects the default:
   1. Multi-Agent Coding, 1 child (recommended and default).
   2. Single-Agent Coding, 0 children.
   3. Multi-Agent Coding, custom positive child count (enter the integer as free text).
   4. Custom instruction (enter it as free text; map it to a maintained mode and valid count).
3. For option 3, require an explicit positive integer. If it is missing or invalid, ask one focused follow-up and keep the Mode gate unreleased; never substitute one. For option 4, use the text only to derive a maintained Single-Agent or Multi-Agent route and valid count, while recording other task constraints. If it is missing, invalid, ambiguous, conflicting, or requests an unmaintained route, ask one focused clarification and keep the gate unreleased. Custom text cannot override higher-priority permissions, safety, repository, authorization, or capability boundaries, and cannot create a route or capability.
4. Record a valid user selection as `mode_source: explicit`. Record the no-reply or explicit no-preference default as `mode_source: default`, `mode: Multi-Agent Coding`, and `child_count: 1`. Apply the count owner before route release. Keep the mode fixed for the full host Session lifetime, not one user/assistant exchange. Later directives, compaction, and same-Session resume reuse it. The initial count remains fixed except for the Count Gate's exact one-slot increase after actual explicit user approval for a different unoccupied role; this does not reopen mode selection. A Fork with a new Session identity must complete fresh mode/count selection under the Re-entry owner rather than inherit the source Session's choice.
5. Treat the released Multi-Agent count as reserved capacity only. Displaying the menu, selecting a mode, or locking the count never creates or initializes a child. Creation remains subject to the role, output-type, and released-slice gates.

The default selects a workflow mode and reserved count only; it does not bypass a task-level prohibition or create a capability. If a higher-priority restriction forbids children, it controls. If the required record capability is absent, block the dependent route rather than pretending it exists.

No child may be created until the count gate has released a valid positive count, the relevant role and concrete slice are released, and the output is code/configuration implementation or authorship/editing of this Skill's instructions or reference documents. Ordinary non-Skill documentation is authored by the root parent, including in tasks that also contain code changes. If the conversation is already locked to Single-Agent Coding, apply the Re-entry owner before considering any conflicting later instruction.

### Single-Agent Coding

After confirmation, keep all work in the current Session. Do not create, fork, hand off to, message, replace, or otherwise manage a child Agent or additional Session. Structural benefit, verification, documentation/Git needs, bootstrap, recovery, or runtime convenience are not exceptions. Independent verification remains a semantic requirement, but is unavailable on this route.

## Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop optimizations

### ChatGPT Desktop

When the active runtime actually exposes `request_user_input_async`, one question may present the menu with a free-text entry path, for example: `request_user_input_async({questions: [{title: "Select a Coding mode", options: ["1. Multi-Agent Coding, 1 child (recommended/default)", "2. Single-Agent Coding, 0 children", "3. Multi-Agent Coding, custom positive child count", "4. Custom instruction"]}]})`. The tool accepts at most 1–3 questions; options do not disable free-text answers, and the answer arrives asynchronously as a new user message. A preselected first option is not a submitted user choice. The tool cannot show a text field conditionally only for options 3 or 4, so state in the same prompt that option 3 requires a positive integer and option 4 requires the complete instruction; use the focused follow-up from the general rules for missing or invalid input. Do not infer a choice while the response is pending. If no valid choice arrives and the Mode gate must be released to proceed, apply the default; do not introduce a timer. If the tool is not exposed, send the numbered menu as ordinary text and receive the response through the normal conversation channel. Never use GUI or Computer Use to present or operate the menu.

### Codex CLI

In Codex CLI, present the four-option numbered menu as plain text, for example `1. Multi-Agent Coding, 1 child (recommended/default); 2. Single-Agent Coding, 0 children; 3. Multi-Agent Coding, custom positive child count; 4. Custom instruction`. Receive a later text reply such as `3: 4` or `4: ...` for the custom instruction; this does not assume a structured form. If no valid choice arrives and the Mode gate must be released to proceed, apply the default; do not introduce a timer. No structured form/input tool is assumed in this Session, so do not claim a conditional input field exists. If the terminal cannot surface a reply, keep the gate unreleased unless it must be released to proceed; then follow the general default or focused follow-up rules without adding a time limit.

# Coding 委派模式确认

## 通用规范

### 会话模式选择

宿主识别的 Session 生命周期中，第一次 Coding 指令到达后，根父级必须：

1. 直接遵循指令中明确给出的有效模式/数量选择，不再询问。
2. 若没有有效选择，呈现以下编号菜单。只有必须放行 Mode gate 且仍没有有效用户选择时，才采用所示缺省值；仅仅尚未收到对提问的回复，并不要求放行门禁。用户明确表示无偏好时也选择缺省值：

   3. Multi-Agent Coding，自定义正整数子代理数（通过自由文本填写整数）。
   4. 自定义指令（通过自由文本填写完整指令，并映射到受维护的模式和有效数量）。

5. 将已放行的 Multi-Agent 数量视为仅预留容量。展示菜单、选择模式或锁定数量均不会创建或初始化子代理；创建仍受职责、输出类型和已放行切片门禁约束。

只有数量门禁放行有效正整数数量、相关职责和具体切片均已放行，且输出属于代码/配置实现或本 Skill 指令/参考文档的编写编辑时，才可创建子代理。普通非 Skill 文档由根父级编写，即使任务同时包含代码修改也一样。如果本次会话已经锁定为单代理 Coding，遇到冲突的后续指令时先遵循模式重新进入 owner。

# Coding Execution Control

## General rules

### Interaction Slice

Release one **Interaction Slice** at a time for non-simple work. Every slice states:

- `Objective`: the result it must produce;
- `Authorized scope/mutations`: paths, behavior, and writes allowed;
- `Return conditions`: the evidence or milestone that ends it;
- `Unreleased boundary`: the next subsystem, risk domain, semantic choice, or mutation that remains blocked.

A slice is a control unit, not a command-by-command script. The executor may continue through low-decision-density mechanics while the Contract and boundary remain unchanged. It must pause at the return conditions or before crossing the unreleased boundary. A simple fast-path task may remain one slice through implementation and focused checks.

### Slice ordering

Release slices in parallel only when they are independent and non-conflicting. Dependencies, shared write targets, or ordered results require sequential release. Context transport and parent-only feedback follow their respective owner protocols and are not defined here.

### Control Checkpoint

At a material boundary, consume the Progress Signal owned by execution stage feedback (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.1199cd05bec7fedb"],"max_chars":11559})`), append the current `Unreleased boundary`, and make one final control choice: `Continue`, `Amend`, or `Stop`. Focus Control on material deviation, new evidence, or an actual boundary; do not turn a released slice into per-command approvals or repeat unchanged status. `Continue` releases only the next bounded slice; `Amend` changes the Contract or boundary before work resumes. `Evidence-on-Demand` is an intermediate evidence request that pauses release and returns to this checkpoint; it is not a fourth final authorization outcome. In a Single-Agent route, this is an internal reasoning pause, not a simulated self-message.

## Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop optimizations

Where enabled, Codex `PreToolUse` can deny a supported `Bash`, edit, or MCP call before it executes; `PostToolUse` is observation **after** the call. Codex's plan/read-only or other permission modes are tool controls, not this Skill's `Continue` decision. Coverage has exceptions, so do not use a hook as the only proof of a filesystem or semantic authorization boundary. [OpenAI: hooks](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks).

### Native approvals and focused review

Before relying on a non-managed Codex hook, inspect and trust its exact definition; in a CLI session that exposes it, run `/hooks` to review or trust configured hooks. A `PreToolUse` command hook denies a supported local call by writing this JSON to stdout:

```json
{
  "hookSpecificOutput": {
    "hookEventName": "PreToolUse",
    "permissionDecision": "deny",
    "permissionDecisionReason": "Explain the blocked operation."
  }
}
```

For this event, `continue: false` is unsupported and the tool call continues after the hook error; `PostToolUse` runs after the effect and cannot retroactively approve it. At a stage boundary, an Agent must inspect the actual working-tree diff with an authorized read-only diff tool, or invoke `/diff` in a Codex CLI session that exposes the command. `/diff` includes staged, unstaged, and untracked changes. The parent still makes the semantic `Continue`/`Amend`/`Stop` choice under the general rules. [OpenAI: PreToolUse output contract](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks), [OpenAI: code review](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/code-review), [OpenAI: CLI diff](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/developer-commands).

# Coding Execution Control

## 通用规范

### Interaction Slice

对于非简单工作，每次只放行一个 **Interaction Slice**。每个 slice 必须写明：

- `Objective`：必须产出的结果；
- `Authorized scope/mutations`：允许的路径、行为和写入；
- `Return conditions`：结束 slice 的证据或里程碑；
- `Unreleased boundary`：仍被阻塞的下一个子系统、风险域、语义选择或变更。

Slice 是控制单元，不是逐命令脚本。只要 Contract 和边界未变，执行者可以继续处理低决策密度的机械步骤；到达 return conditions 或跨越未放行边界前必须暂停。简单的快路径任务可以将实现和聚焦检查保留在一个 slice 中。

### Slice 顺序

只有相互独立且不冲突的 slice 才可并行放行。存在依赖、共享写入目标或有序结果时必须顺序放行。上下文传输和仅限父级的反馈遵循各自 owner 协议，本文档不定义这些内容。

### Control Checkpoint

到达实质性边界时，消费执行阶段反馈 (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"implementation","context_version":2,"language":"zh_cn","fragment_ids":["unit.1199cd05bec7fedb"],"max_chars":5499})`)定义的 Progress Signal，附加当前 `Unreleased boundary`，再选择一个最终控制结果：`Continue`、`Amend` 或 `Stop`。Control 聚焦实质偏离、新证据或真实边界；不要把已放行 slice 变成逐命令审批，也不要重复无变化状态。`Continue` 只放行下一个有界 Slice；`Amend` 必须先修改 Contract 或边界再恢复执行。`Evidence-on-Demand` 是暂停放行并请求证据的中间动作，取得证据后重新经过本检查点；它不是第四种最终授权结果。单代理路线中这是内部推理暂停，不模拟发给自己的消息。

## Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop 特别优化指令

### 原生审批与聚焦审查

  "hookSpecificOutput": {
    "hookEventName": "PreToolUse",
    "permissionDecision": "deny",
    "permissionDecisionReason": "说明拒绝该操作的原因。"

# Coding Execution Planning

## General rules

### Two-level planning

Translate an approved direction into bounded inspection, implementation, and focused-check steps. The plan records the stage outline and the evidence each stage is expected to produce without turning stages into a command list.

### Reconnaissance to implementation release

When project facts are needed before a material decision, plan a bounded reconnaissance slice that returns compressed facts, evidence-backed options, and unresolved questions. The decision gate then confirms or rejects the direction before implementation is released. Planning does not approve a new semantic or architecture direction. The shared task plan is persisted by default under Task Plan Memory Lifecycle (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.c3c732f022fc8a5e"],"max_chars":27855})`); an explicit planning request is unnecessary. Dedicated planning modes are optional drafting paths. Keep the plan separate from live parent scheduling state.

## Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop optimizations

In an interactive Codex CLI or an Agent Session that exposes the direct `/plan` command, invoke `/plan` to enter Plan mode; optionally append the first planning request, for example `/plan Propose a migration plan for this service`. Codex uses that prompt to draft an execution plan before implementation. The command is unavailable while Codex is already working; when no direct `/plan` control is exposed, use the general bounded planning process. By default, persist the concise synthesized plan and complete any required verification under Task Plan Memory Lifecycle (instruction continuation: `rules_get_context(payload={"node_id":"decision","context_version":2,"language":"en","fragment_ids":["unit.c3c732f022fc8a5e"],"max_chars":27855})`); `/plan` is an optional drafting path; the transcript is not the plan record. # Task Plan Memory Lifecycle

## General rules

### Default task plan

Every current and future Coding route must consume this owner before implementation and throughout execution. An explicit request for a plan or a dedicated planning mode is unnecessary. Respect an explicit user prohibition on persistence or a higher-priority write restriction: record that exception and keep bounded planning in the authorized context; do not silently treat missing tools, uncertain permissions, or a failed write as an exception. If the user requires a persisted plan and a restriction prevents it, stop the dependent work and report the conflict.

For an Issue task, read the Issue and relevant discussion, compare its requirements with current project facts, and synthesize the proposed change before implementation. Without an Issue, use the user's stated problem and current project facts in the same way. Before the initial analysis is complete, a concise provisional plan may capture the goal, known facts, and unanswered questions; it must not claim an implementation direction is released. Persist the concrete plan before implementation or dependent dispatch, and confirm that the authorized write operation succeeded. Review the proposed plan in the authorized context before writing; a normal successful write does not by itself require an immediate full readback. New facts that affect a dependent action must be recorded before that action; batch other material facts for the next applicable plan boundary.

### Names, storage, and initial evidence

Reuse the user's designated active plan for the same task. Before choosing a new name, confirm whether the authorized backend uses shared global storage or legacy project-local storage. In shared global storage, both active and archived plans must include the same verified repository key: `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` and `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`. Optionally include a verified Issue number; omit `.md` from logical Memory names. Never place a new global plan directly in shared `plans/` or `archive-plans/`, and never use a basename, branch, remote URL, or worktree path as the repository key.

For this storage mapping, the repository key is `git-v1-` followed by the hexadecimal SHA-256 of `b"token-io-decoupling:git-common-dir:v1\0" + os.fsencode(str(canonical_git_common_dir))`, where `\0` denotes one NUL byte. Resolve the actual checkout root and canonical absolute Git common directory using trusted local repository facts. The main checkout and its linked worktrees share that common directory and key; independent repositories and independent clones have separate keys, even with identical names or remotes. Moving the common directory changes the key: stop to reconcile the old mapping rather than silently abandoning or migrating its plans. Missing or ambiguous repository identity blocks the global path. This is a local repository identity, not a portable identifier across machines. Reusing an old common-directory path reuses its key; confirm ownership and reconcile existing history before accepting a newly created repository at that path.

With an explicitly retained project-local backend, use `plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` and `archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`; the default physical root is `<project-root>/.serena/memories/`. That compatibility mode does not provide cross-worktree sharing. Follow the actual configured Memory root and mapping, including authorized data-directory overrides; do not create a second store or invent a global root. Once shared global storage is selected, unavailable identity, root, mapping, or permission blocks that path instead of silently falling back to project-local storage. For a user-designated name, establish its corresponding archive mapping within existing authorization. Existing plans and archives keep their original mapping unless a separate authorized migration establishes ownership, checks collisions, preserves every byte, and verifies the result; never automatically adopt unscoped data from another project or rewrite an existing archive.

Confirm the exact project/worktree binding, storage scope, repository key when global, and effective memory-maintenance guidance. Reuse a plan name already supplied by the authorized task or available in current context; list only the selected repository's plan topics when name discovery is needed. Read an existing matching plan when its contents are needed and are not already current in context. A global listing may expose other repositories; visibility grants no authority to read or mutate them. Reuse only a plan for the same ongoing task; preserve unrelated plans and choose a distinct name on collision. Review the concrete plan before writing and confirm successful persistence before dependent work. Refresh the full stored content only when required to resolve an information gap, stale or invalidated context, a writer change, suspected concurrent change, conflict, uncertain operation, or explicit content-verification requirement. Missing required Memory capability, inaccessible required content, failed persistence, or failed required verification blocks dependent work; report the exact operation and preserve the last confirmed plan.

### Plan content

Keep one concise shared plan with the goal and acceptance conditions; Issue or user-request source; constraints and non-goals; verified project facts and exact source pointers; chosen direction and unresolved questions; bounded steps, dependencies, and verification approach; completed/current/remaining work; actual checks, blockers, and residual risks. Distinguish facts, assumptions, proposals, and accepted decisions. Use compact deltas and useful current evidence rather than transcripts, full diffs, logs, or private reasoning. Concision applies to new entries; it never permits replacing accumulated content with a current-state or final summary. Preserve existing goals, constraints, requirement changes, sourced facts, decision reasons, stage progress, shared contributions, failures, and verification records. Mark a stale conclusion as superseded, retaining its original claim and evidence and adding the replacement, reason, and source; do not silently delete or rewrite its history.

### Preservation checks for plan updates

1. For a preservation comparison or whole-document replacement, use a complete current plan as the baseline. It may be a complete read already held in current context for the same uninterrupted, parent-coordinated writer turn, combined with that writer's explicitly successful changes. Refresh the complete plan if the baseline is missing, stale, invalidated, or a writer handoff, suspected concurrent change, conflict, or uncertain result occurred. An outline or unconfirmed contribution is not a baseline.
2. Merge only authorized status/step changes and append new facts, results, or evidence. Prefer a precise local edit when its target is unambiguous; use literal matching with protection against unintended multiple matches. Before whole-document replacement, obtain the applicable complete baseline and submit the full merged document, never a newly drafted summary. Review the candidate against the baseline so every prior record, contribution, provenance, reason, and evidence remains traceable; apply the supersession rule above to changed conclusions.
3. A successful write/edit receipt confirms execution, not semantic correctness, content preservation, or concurrency control. In the same uninterrupted controlled writer turn, the confirmed change may be added to the held baseline without rereading the full plan after each update. Read back stored content when explicitly required, when actual stored-content acceptance is being performed, or when an error, conflict, invalidation, or uncertain result requires it. When triggered, compare the complete relevant content and confirm new entries separately; an ordinary successful write or a spot check is not a substitute for a required comparison.
4. Missing content, conflicting contributions, or uncertain write/read results block affected reporting, dependent actions, and archiving. Preserve the last confirmed baseline, refresh current state, and reconcile under existing authorization before rechecking. Never blindly replay a stale replacement. Keep comparisons within authorized context; do not persist transcripts or private reasoning.

### Update boundaries and dependent actions

Every participating Agent, including the parent and any verifier, uses the same current plan context when needed on entry/resume; refresh it when required content is absent or stale. Record material progress and sourced facts at applicable phase, handoff, pause, or completion boundaries. Batch related updates within a phase; ordinary progress reports and unrelated small facts do not independently trigger a write. A fact that changes authorization, scope, acceptance, direction, or a dependent action must be recorded and analyzed before that affected action. A successful update does not by itself require an immediate readback; follow the preservation and uncertainty triggers above.

For a changed user requirement, first record the new instruction and its source as pending analysis. Then analyze its impact on scope, dependencies, acceptance, and the proposed solution; persist the analysis and revised plan, confirm the write operation, and perform any content verification triggered by this owner before proceeding. Only afterward may the parent authorize affected changes or dispatch. If the change arrives in a child context, submit it within the child's permitted contribution and return it to the parent; the child cannot amend the Contract or release work. Keep unaffected authorized work available only when it does not depend on the pending change.

### Shared access and update coordination

The parent supplies the exact project root, Memory name, relevant source scope, and allowed contributions in every affected dispatch. Determine which read, contribution-return, or write operations each assigned role actually needs; a shared name does not establish cross-Session access. The parent may merge an explicitly authorized, concise contribution while acting as the current record writer. Do not require every contributor to have Memory write tools, and do not treat one Agent's successful call as proof of another Agent's access. Missing required read access blocks work that depends on the inaccessible plan; failed persistence or required verification blocks dependent work. Never use an unverified contribution or filesystem file as a substitute for required shared-plan evidence.

Serialize updates to the shared plan. The parent coordinates one current record writer at a time. Other roles may submit concise, sourced contributions within their released scope; this does not grant them permission to write or read other records. A writer may reuse its complete held baseline and its own confirmed updates during the same uninterrupted controlled turn. Refresh after writer handoff or on evidence of concurrent change, conflict, invalidation, or uncertain outcome. Do not assume atomic compare-and-swap or locks from a Memory tool. Pause affected reporting/actions when the current state cannot be established; reconcile under the parent's existing authorization and never blindly overwrite or retry a stale full document.

The plan is shared task context, not the live parent mode/count/allocation/epoch record, an execution memo, or a source of authorization. Do not store that live scheduling state in it. Plan read/write access grants no access to other Memories, source files, raw peer context, or new effects. Respect the Context Firewall and each role's released scope; return proposals through the parent. A verifier may update only its named plan contribution and remains read-only for implementation and Git. A false execution-memo flag does not waive shared task-plan updates.

### Completion and archive

Keep the plan active while the task is incomplete or blocked. After every applicable Acceptance criterion passes:

1. Apply the preservation checks above to the complete active plan: update only completion status/steps and append final results, Acceptance evidence, and remaining limitations. Retain the accumulated document; a final summary may be appended but must never replace it. Before archiving, satisfy the required full content-preservation check using the selected lifecycle tool's verified receipt or, when using native Memory operations, the necessary complete content comparison.
2. Retain this verified final active content as the archive baseline and confirm the matching archive target is absent. Archive only this completed task's plan by moving its namespace/name, without changing its content. A collision blocks the move; preserve both entries and report it.
3. Verify the archived content is identical to the final active baseline and confirm the archive exists and the active name is absent. Use a matching verified archive receipt when the configured lifecycle service provides one; otherwise perform the necessary complete archive read and comparison. A missing record, content difference, or update/archive/required-verification failure blocks completion; preserve the last confirmed state and resolve uncertain effects before proceeding.

Archived plans are instruction-level immutable: never edit, delete, rename, or replace an existing archive, including to repair a failed archive comparison; tool visibility does not technically enforce this rule. Report such a mismatch for a separate authorized recovery decision. Never archive an unrelated or incomplete plan.

### Preservation acceptance scenario

Use a new synthetic plan in an authorized test scope, never an existing user's plan. Include multiple stages, a goal and constraint, a sourced requirement change, a decision with its reason, another contributor's entry, a failed check and later passing check. Include small facts such as “two untracked-file manifests verified” and “no PR template found” so a short final summary cannot accidentally pass. Supersede one conclusion with a reason and source, complete through the checks above, then archive. Verify every original record remains traceable, the superseded claim and its replacement both remain, final results were appended, the archive equals the final active baseline, and the active name disappeared. Also review a summary-only candidate and an occupied archive target: neither may advance to a write/move that loses content or overwrites an archive. Report actual exercised checks separately from scenario review; this does not prove tool-enforced immutability or recover past losses.

## Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop optimizations

### Configured deterministic lifecycle tools

When the workflow MCP profile exposes an authorized, configured Serena backend, use `task_plan_update`, `task_plan_complete`, and `task_plan_archive` for plan mutations. Discovery alone is insufficient: confirm backend availability, the exact configured checkout, and the returned storage scope/repository mapping. For shared global storage, the operator explicitly constructs `SerenaMemoryStore(memory_manager, project_root, storage_scope="global")` from the actual Serena `MemoryManager`; the compatibility default remains `storage_scope="project"`. Explicit server injection or a trusted startup factory supplies that service. The global root must already exist; the service neither initializes it nor guesses its location. Do not invent a factory, load arbitrary code from a tool argument, install a dependency, or guess a `.serena` directory to make a call pass. The service does not automatically load or migrate Serena configuration.

Each request still supplies the exact service-bound checkout's absolute `project_root`; it cannot choose another repository or switch storage scope. Separately configured services for the main checkout and linked worktrees derive the same global repository identity, history, revision and replay scope. Inspect the returned scoped `memory_name` rather than rebuilding a bare name. Global history uses an explicit repository identity; legacy project history remains checkout-bound. The service checks repository identity again before global Memory effects and fails if it changed. Capability/receipt evidence does not authenticate the caller or grant access to other repositories. Git's common-directory semantics are documented in [git-rev-parse](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-rev-parse) and [repository layout](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitrepository-layout).

| Operation | Agent input and required result |
| --- | --- |
| `task_plan_update` | Submit only typed records with stable IDs, text and sources, the expected content revision, and an operation ID. Creation must explicitly expect absence. Adopt existing Markdown by retaining its opaque original content and appending typed records; declare goals and acceptance criteria rather than inferring them. A replacement references an existing record and supplies its reason; the old record remains. Never send a replacement document, free-form patch or regex. |
| `task_plan_complete` | Supply final results, limitations, the expected revision and operation ID, and evidence mapping every current declared criterion to passed verification records. Resolve blockers through appended records first. The service validates structure and preservation; it cannot prove the truth or semantic sufficiency of supplied evidence. |
| `task_plan_archive` | Supply the completed active plan identity and expected revision. The destination is the corresponding fixed archive namespace. Require an identical-content receipt and active-name absence; do not request reference propagation or arbitrary destination changes. |

Use each currently exposed payload schema for exact fields and bounds. The service performs the full baseline read, structured merge, preservation checks and readback internally; inspect its compact receipt for the matching project/plan, revision, state, replay and preservation result before relying on success. When that receipt verifies the requested operation and content-preservation result, do not repeat the same full readback through native Memory tools. A revision conflict requires reading and reviewing current state before a new request. Identical update/completion retries reuse the original operation ID and payload; a changed payload needs a new ID. Reconciliation-required or uncertain effects block dependent work; do not bypass a selected service's failure by invoking raw Memory writes. These deterministic operations make no model or network requests.

The adapter honors Serena memory access policies and operates on its actual canonical files. Its lock serializes cooperating lifecycle-tool calls; direct Serena tools and external writers do not automatically join that lock. Do not claim global compare-and-swap, raw-tool ACLs, or immutable archives against outside writes. Stronger enforcement requires the host to restrict those other write channels. Missing host enforcement does not establish an unavailable capability or prevent unrelated authorized work; report the precise protection boundary.

### Native Memory path

If no configured lifecycle service has been selected, use only the Serena operations actually exposed and authorized, with all general preservation and storage-scope checks above: `list_memories`, `read_memory`, `write_memory` or `edit_memory`, and a permitted archive operation. Confirm project activation, the actual global-root mapping when selected, the verified repository key, and exact schemas. List only the relevant plan topic when discovering a name. A normal successful write/edit result confirms execution and does not require an immediate full `read_memory`; refresh and compare stored content only at the triggers defined above. `write_memory` replaces the named content, so do not use it for an update without the applicable full baseline; prefer a precise authorized `edit_memory` for a bounded change. Filter any global listing to `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans` or its corresponding archive topic. Supply logical names, never an absolute filesystem path as `memory_name`. If the current tools cannot establish the required identity or mapping, block the shared path; do not replace it with a worktree-local copy. Native `rename_memory` propagates `mem:` references, so establish that its effects remain authorized and the final content comparison can pass; otherwise stop that archive step. Never treat it as an atomic no-clobber primitive. Native `/plan`, local recall and chat compaction do not persist this shared record. One Session's successful calls do not prove another Agent's access; check each assigned Agent. [Codex MCP](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp).

## 硬约束

# 任务计划 Memory 生命周期

## 通用规范

### 默认任务计划

所有现有及未来 Coding 路线都必须在实施前及执行全过程消费本 owner，无需用户额外要求计划或进入专用规划模式。遵守用户明确禁止持久化或更高优先级的写入限制：记录该例外，在获授权上下文内保持有界规划；工具缺失、权限不明或写入失败不得静默当作例外。若用户要求持久化计划而限制阻止持久化，则停止依赖工作并报告冲突。

有 Issue 时，先读取 Issue 和相关讨论，结合当前项目事实分析要求，在实施前综合改动方案。无 Issue 时，对用户明确提出的问题和当前项目事实采用相同流程。初始分析完成前，可用简明的临时计划记录目标、已知事实和待解问题，但不得声称已释放实现方向。实施或依赖派发前，持久化具体计划并确认获准写入操作成功。写入前在获授权上下文审阅计划方案；普通成功写入本身不要求立即全文读回。影响依赖动作的新事实须在该动作前记录；其他实质事实可合并到下一适用计划边界。

### 名称、存储和初始证据

优先复用用户为同一任务指定的 active plan。选择新名称前，确认获准后端使用共享全局存储还是旧版项目本地存储。共享全局存储中，活动与归档规划都必须带同一个已核验仓库 key：`global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` 与 `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`。可包含已核实的 Issue 编号；逻辑 Memory 名不含 `.md`。新全局规划不得直接放进共享的 `plans/` 或 `archive-plans/`，也不得用目录 basename、分支、remote URL 或 worktree 路径充当仓库 key。

本存储映射的仓库 key 为 `git-v1-` 加上 `b"token-io-decoupling:git-common-dir:v1\0" + os.fsencode(str(canonical_git_common_dir))` 的十六进制 SHA-256，其中 `\0` 表示一个 NUL 字节。通过可信本地仓库事实解析实际 checkout 根目录和 canonical absolute Git common directory。主工作区和 linked worktrees 共享该目录及 key；独立仓库和独立 clone 使用不同 key，即使名称或 remote 相同。共同目录搬迁会改变 key：应停止并核对旧映射，不得静默丢弃或迁移其规划。缺少或无法确定仓库身份时，阻塞全局路径。这是本机仓库身份，不是跨机器可移植标识。复用旧共同目录路径会复用其 key；在该路径接受新建仓库前，须确认归属并核对已有历史。

明确保留项目本地后端时，使用 `plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]` 和 `archive-plans/PLAN-[short-english-summary]`；默认物理根为 `<project-root>/.serena/memories/`。该兼容模式不提供跨 worktree 共享。遵从实际配置的 Memory 根和映射，包括获准的数据目录覆盖；不得另建存储或虚构全局根。选定共享全局存储后，身份、根目录、映射或权限不可用时阻塞该路径，不得静默回退项目本地存储。用户自定名称的对应归档映射须在既有授权内明确。已有规划/归档保留原映射，除非另行获准的迁移确认归属、检查碰撞、保留全部字节并核验结果；不得自动收编其他项目未分层的数据或改写已有归档。

确认准确项目/worktree 绑定、存储 scope、全局模式的仓库 key 和有效的记忆维护说明。复用已授权任务已提供或当前上下文已有的计划名称；只有需要发现名称时，才列出所选仓库的规划 topic。仅在需要且当前上下文没有有效内容时读取已存在的匹配计划。全局列表可能暴露其他仓库；可见不构成读取或修改它们的授权。仅复用同一进行中任务的计划；保留无关计划，碰撞时选择不同名称。写入前审阅具体计划，并在依赖工作前确认持久化操作成功。只有为解决信息缺口、上下文过期或失效、写者变化、疑似并发变化、冲突、结果不明或明确内容验证要求时，才刷新存储全文。必需 Memory 能力缺失、必需内容不可访问、持久化失败或必需核验失败时，阻塞依赖工作；报告准确操作并保留最后确认的计划。

### 计划内容

维护一份精简共享计划，包含目标和验收条件、Issue 或用户请求来源、约束和非目标、已核实项目事实与准确来源指针、所选方向和未解问题、有界步骤/依赖/验证方法、已完成/当前/剩余工作，以及实际检查/阻塞/剩余风险。区分事实、假设、提议和已接受决定。使用精简增量和有用的当前证据，不存 transcript、完整 diff、日志或私有推理。精简适用于新增条目，绝不允许用当前状态或最终摘要替换累积内容。保留已有目标、约束、需求变化、带来源的事实、决策理由、阶段进展、共享贡献、失败和验证记录。过时结论须标记为已替代，保留原结论及证据，并补充替代结论、原因和来源；不得静默删除或改写其历史。

### 计划更新的内容保留检查

1. 需要进行内容保留比对或全文替换时，以完整且当前的计划为基线。同一连续、由父级协调的写者轮次中，当前上下文已持有的完整读取可与该写者明确成功的变更合并作为基线。基线缺失、过期、失效，写者交接、疑似并发变化、冲突或结果不明时，刷新完整计划。提纲或未经确认的贡献不能作为基线。
2. 仅合并获准的状态/步骤变更，并追加新事实、结果或证据。目标明确无歧义时优先精确局部编辑；使用 literal 匹配并防止意外多处匹配。全文替换前，取得适用的完整基线并提交合并后的全文，绝不能重新起草摘要。按基线审阅候选内容，确保每条既有记录、贡献、来源、理由及证据仍可追溯；结论变化遵守上述替代规则。
3. 成功的 write/edit 回执确认操作已执行，不证明语义正确、内容保全或并发控制。同一连续受控写者轮次内，已确认变更可加入当前基线，不必每次更新后重新读取全文。仅在用户明确要求、进行实际存储内容验收，或错误、冲突、失效、结果不明要求时，读回存储内容。触发读回后，比对完整相关内容并单独确认新增条目；普通成功写入或抽查不能替代必需的比对。
4. 内容缺失、贡献冲突或写入/读取结果不明时，阻塞受影响汇报、依赖动作和归档。保留最后确认基线，刷新当前状态，并在既有授权内协调后重新检查。不得盲目重放过时的全文替换。比对仅保留于获授权上下文，不持久化 transcript 或私有推理。

### 更新边界与依赖动作

所有参与 Agent，包括父级和验证者，在进入/恢复任务时按需使用同一计划上下文；所需内容缺失或过期时刷新。实质进展及带来源事实在适用的阶段、交接、暂停或完成边界记录。同一阶段的相关更新可合并；普通进度汇报及无关小事实本身不触发写入。影响授权、范围、验收、方向或依赖动作的事实，仍须在受影响动作前记录并分析。成功更新本身不要求立即读回；遵循上述保全及结果不明触发条件。

用户需求变化时，先把新指令及来源记录为待分析。再分析其对范围、依赖、验收和方案的影响；持久化分析和修订计划，确认写入操作成功，并在继续前执行本 owner 触发的必要内容核验。之后父级才可授权受影响改动或派发。子上下文收到变化时，在获准贡献范围内提交并返回父级；子 Agent 不能修订 Contract 或释放工作。只有不依赖待处理变化时，才可继续不受影响的已授权工作。

### 共享访问与更新协调

父级在每次受影响派发中提供准确项目根目录、Memory 名称、相关来源范围和允许贡献。明确每个已分配角色实际需要的读取、贡献提交或写入操作；共享名称不证明跨 Session 可访问。父级作为当前记录写者时，可合并获明确授权的精简贡献。不得要求每个贡献者都具备 Memory 写入工具，也不得将一个 Agent 的成功调用视为其他 Agent 有访问权。必需读取权限缺失时，阻塞依赖该不可访问计划的工作；持久化失败或必需核验失败时，阻塞依赖工作。不得用未经核验的贡献或文件副本替代必需的共享计划证据。

共享计划更新须串行。父级协调同一时刻一个当前记录写者。其他角色可在已释放范围内向父级提交精简且带来源的贡献；这不授予其读写其他记录的权限。同一连续受控写者轮次内，写者可复用其持有的完整基线和自身已确认更新。写者交接或出现并发变化、冲突、失效、结果不明迹象时刷新。不得假定 Memory 工具提供原子比较交换或锁。无法建立当前状态时，暂停受影响汇报/动作；在父级既有授权内协调，不得盲目覆盖或重试过时全文。

计划是共享任务上下文，不是父级实时 mode/count/allocation/epoch 记录、执行 memo 或授权来源；不得存储这些实时调度状态。计划读写不授予其他 Memory、源文件、原始同级上下文或新效果的访问权。遵守 Context Firewall 和各角色已释放范围；提议通过父级返回。验证者只可更新具名计划贡献，对实现和 Git 仍保持只读。执行 memo 标志为 false 不豁免共享任务计划更新。

### 完成与归档

任务未完成或阻塞时保持计划活动。所有适用 Acceptance 条件通过后：

1. 对完整活动计划应用上述内容保留检查：仅更新完成状态/步骤，并追加最终结果、Acceptance 证据和剩余限制。保留累积文档；可追加最终摘要，但绝不能用其替换全文。归档前通过所选生命周期工具的核验回执，或在使用原生 Memory 操作时通过必要的完整内容比对，满足内容保全检查。
2. 保留已验证的最终活动内容作为归档基线，并确认匹配归档目标不存在。仅通过移动命名空间/名称归档本次已完成任务的计划，内容不得变化。碰撞时阻塞移动，保留两个条目并报告。
3. 核实归档内容与最终活动基线完全相同，并确认归档存在且活动名称已不存在。配置的生命周期服务提供匹配的核验归档回执时使用该回执；否则执行必要的归档全文读取和比较。记录缺失、内容差异或更新/归档/必需核验失败均阻塞完成；保留最后确认状态，解决结果不明的效果后才能继续。

已有归档在指令层面不可变：不得编辑、删除、重命名或替换，包括为修复失败的归档比对而修改；工具可见不会技术性强制该规则。此类不一致须报告，交由另行获准的恢复决定处理。不得归档无关或未完成计划。

### 内容保留验收场景

在获准测试范围内使用新建的合成计划，绝不使用用户既有计划。包含多个阶段、目标和约束、带来源的需求变化、有理由的决策、其他贡献者条目、失败检查及后续通过检查。包含“两份未跟踪文件清单已核验”“未发现 PR 模板”等小事实，防止简短最终摘要意外通过。对一项结论注明替代原因和来源，经过上述检查完成计划，再归档。验证每条原记录仍可追溯，旧结论和替代结论并存，最终结果为追加内容，归档等于最终活动基线，且活动名称已消失。另外审查仅含摘要的候选和已占用的归档目标：两者均不得推进至会丢失内容的写入或覆盖归档的移动。分别报告实际演练检查和场景审查；这不证明工具强制不可变，也不恢复过去丢失的内容。

## Codex CLI / ChatGPT Desktop 特别优化指令

### 已配置的确定性生命周期工具

workflow MCP profile 暴露已授权且已配置的 Serena 后端时，使用 `task_plan_update`、`task_plan_complete`、`task_plan_archive` 修改计划。仅发现工具不足以继续：须确认后端可用、准确配置 checkout，以及返回的存储 scope/仓库映射。共享全局模式由操作者以实际 Serena `MemoryManager` 显式构建 `SerenaMemoryStore(memory_manager, project_root, storage_scope="global")`；兼容默认值仍为 `storage_scope="project"`。通过显式服务注入或受信任启动 factory 提供该服务。实际全局根须已存在；服务不会初始化或猜测其位置。不得为了让调用通过而虚构 factory、从工具参数加载任意代码、安装依赖或猜测 `.serena` 目录。服务不会自动加载或迁移 Serena 配置。

每个请求仍提供该服务绑定 checkout 的准确绝对 `project_root`，不能选择其他仓库或切换存储 scope。主工作区及 linked worktrees 分别配置的服务派生同一全局仓库身份、history、revision 和 replay scope。检查返回的带项目层级 `memory_name`，不要重建裸名称。全局 history 使用明确仓库身份；旧项目 history 仍绑定 checkout。服务在全局 Memory 效果前重新核对仓库身份，发生改变则失败。capability/receipt 证据不认证调用者，也不授予其他仓库访问权。Git 共同目录语义见 [git-rev-parse](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-rev-parse) 和[仓库布局](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitrepository-layout)。

| 操作 | Agent 输入与必需结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `task_plan_update` | 仅提交具有稳定 ID、文本和来源的类型化记录，以及预期内容版本和操作 ID。创建须明确预期名称不存在。接管已有 Markdown 时，保留其不透明原文并追加类型化记录；显式声明目标和验收标准，不自动推断。替代须引用已有记录并给出原因，旧记录仍保留。绝不提交替换全文、自由格式 patch 或 regex。 |
| `task_plan_complete` | 提供最终结果、限制、预期版本和操作 ID，并将每项当前已声明标准映射到通过的验证记录。先通过追加记录解决 blocker。服务验证结构与内容保留，不能证明输入证据的真实性或语义充分性。 |
| `task_plan_archive` | 提供已完成活动计划身份和预期版本。目标固定为对应归档命名空间。要求内容完全一致的回执及活动名称消失；不得请求引用传播或任意改变目标。 |

准确字段和边界使用当前暴露的 payload schema。服务内部完成全文基线读取、结构化合并、内容保留检查与读回；依赖成功前，检查精简回执中的匹配项目/计划、版本、状态、重放及内容保留结果。回执核实请求操作和内容保留结果后，不得再通过原生 Memory 工具重复全文读回同一内容。版本冲突后，先读取并审阅当前状态，再提出新请求。完全相同的更新/完成重试复用原操作 ID 与 payload；payload 变化须使用新 ID。需要协调或效果不明时阻塞依赖工作；不得用原始 Memory 写入绕过已选服务的失败。这些确定性操作不发起模型或网络请求。

适配器遵守 Serena Memory 访问策略，并操作其实际规范文件。其锁只串行协调参与生命周期工具的调用；原始 Serena 工具和外部写者不会自动参与该锁。不得声称具有针对外部写入的全局比较交换、原始工具 ACL 或归档不可变保证。更强强制边界须由宿主限制其他写入通道。宿主未提供该强制边界不证明其他能力不可用，也不阻止无关获准工作；须准确报告保护范围。

### 原生 Memory 路径

未选择已配置的生命周期服务时，仅使用实际暴露且获准的 Serena 操作，并完成上述全部通用内容保留与存储 scope 检查：`list_memories`、`read_memory`、`write_memory` 或 `edit_memory`，以及获准的归档操作。确认项目激活、选定全局模式的实际根映射、已核验仓库 key 和准确 schema。发现名称时只列出相关计划 topic。普通成功写入/edit 结果确认操作已执行，不要求立即调用全文 `read_memory`；只在上述触发条件下刷新并比较存储内容。`write_memory` 会替换具名 Memory 的全部内容，未取得适用完整基线时不得用它更新；有限变更优先使用获准且精确的 `edit_memory`。全局列表限定为 `global/token-io-decoupling/repos/<repository-id>/plans` 或其对应归档 topic。提供逻辑名称，不得以绝对文件系统路径作为 `memory_name`。当前工具无法确认必需身份或映射时，阻塞共享路径，不得新建 worktree 本地副本替代。原生 `rename_memory` 会传播 `mem:` 引用，因此须先确认效果仍在授权范围内且最终内容比对能够通过，否则停止该归档步骤。绝不把它当成原子禁止覆盖原语。原生 `/plan`、本地回忆和聊天压缩不能持久化此共享记录。一个 Session 的成功调用不证明另一 Agent 的访问权；每个分配 Agent 均须检查。[Codex MCP](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp)。
